page.overview:
Who is Angstrom Jr.?

Angstrom Jr. was the son of a variant of Angstrom Levy. He is a minor character in Invincible.

Little is known about Angstrom Jr, except he was Angstrom Levy's son and has a pet red fox named "Chainsaw."

At some point, Capevincible killed Angstrom Jr's mom and so he and his father went into hiding.

Angstrom and Angstrom Jr hid in a secret vault like base, telling his father that he missed his mom. They were then interrupted by Capevincible, who quickly killed Jr as his father helplessly watched.
